subject: POC Risk Tracker & Next Steps for Stellar Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@stellarcommerce.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC Risk Tracker & Next Steps for Stellar Commerce

Hi Rachel / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned for the POC: 

High-level success criteria (your team to confirm):
- Serve production-like traffic (peak 150 rps) with 95th percentile latency under 250ms for text-generation endpoints.
- Vector embeddings similarity within your existing search baseline (precision drop <= 3%).
- No data persistence outside of your VPC (Redwood Private setup) for the trial dataset.
- Integration with your auth proxy and audit logging enabled for all inference calls.

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Redwood: provide a dedicated trial environment, sample dataset loader, and the initial config for batching/quantization. Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Stellar: provide a representative dataset (up to 100k records) and API keys for the proxy. Owner: Rachel Chen.
- QA/Test plan: Tommy or Dev from Stellar will run the smoke tests and share results in the tracker.

Timeline (proposed):
- 2026-07-22: Redwood provides environment + mutual-action-plan (attached).
- 2026-07-24 to 07-28: Data load + integration smoke tests.
- 2026-07-29: Performance evaluation run and results.
- 2026-08-05: Wrap up call and next steps (expansion/commit conversation).

Blocking risks called out on the call:
1) Network/Proxy auth mismatch: may prevent test harness from hitting the environment — mitigation: we’ll provide a short-lived bypass token and an auth header mapping doc.
2) Model latency variability on long contexts — mitigation: initial token limits and a tuned batching profile.
3) Potential bug in Stellar’s sample payload parser (Tom mentioned one client saw a crash).

Action items for this thread:
- Rachel/Tom: confirm the success criteria and timeline (reply here).
- Rachel: share sample dataset link and proxy test credentials by 07/22.
- Redwood: upload the POC tracker and mutual-action-plan (attached).

Attachments: poc-risk-tracker.xlsx (tracker), mutual-action-plan.docx

Thanks — I’ll update the tracker as items move.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Risk Tracker & Next Steps for Stellar Commerce

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful and aligns with our expectations. A couple of clarifications: 

- Confirming success criteria above; we’ll add a small business metric (95% of search queries return acceptable result in top 3).
- We’ll share the sample dataset by EOD 07/22.
- On the parser crash: our integration engineer (Tom) reproduced the crash and attached a screenshot — it looks like a Unicode/escape issue in one payload. I’ve attached the screenshot and highlighted the offending payload.

We’ll try the workaround of normalizing the payloads on our side, but if Redwood can add a defensive parsing fallback that tolerates the escape sequences it would speed things up. Also, regarding audit/logging, what retention options do you support during a trial?

Attachments: screenshot-blocking-bug.png

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, Stellar Commerce
rachel.chen@stellarcommerce.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Risk Tracker & Next Steps for Stellar Commerce — blocking bug (JIRA-3124)

Looping in eng to triage the parser crash Rachel found.

Quick plan:
- Ethan: can you own a triage and patch for the payload parsing tolerance? Please create a short repro and open JIRA-3124, mark Priority=High since this blocks the smoke tests.
- Monica: can you update the tracker with a mitigation row and temporary workaround (payload normalization on Stellar side)?
- Marissa: I’ll coordinate an escalation path if the patch takes longer than 48 hours — we’ll escalate to Rishi (SRE lead) and pull in the runtime team.

Escalation path:
- 24h: dev triage + patch attempt (Ethan).
- 48h: escalate to Rishi for a hotfix deployment window.
- 72h+: consider offering a short-term hosted proxy fallback while we fix parser (customer winback).

Thanks — let’s treat JIRA-3124 as the single source of truth for this blocking issue.

—Aditya

Subject: RE: POC Risk Tracker — patch and temporary mitigation

Hi Rachel / Tom —

We reproduced the crash and pushed a defensive parser patch to the trial environment this morning (attached patch-2026-07-27.zip). The fix tolerates malformed escape sequences and falls back to a sanitized string. Steps to test:
1) Pull new endpoint config: POST /config/reload (we pushed the new build to the trial cluster).
2) Retry the payload that failed (I included a small repro script in the zip).

If you still see failures, please send the failing payload (or sample IDs) and we’ll triage immediately. If the patch mitigates the issue, we’ll close JIRA-3124 and proceed with the smoke tests.

Escalation note: if any regression appears during performance runs, Rishi will own the hotfix window and coordinate an emergency rollback.

Thanks —
Ethan Park
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stellarcommerce.com>

Subject: Re: POC Risk Tracker & Next Steps for Stellar Commerce

Ethan — confirmed the patched build fixed the parser issue on our sample payloads. We ran the smoke tests this morning and everything passed. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

We’re good to proceed with the performance run on 07/30. One ask: can we get audit log retention set to 14 days for the trial window? Also, can we have a 30-minute sync after the performance run to review results (suggested time: 4pm PT)?

Confirmed items:
- Parser crash (JIRA-3124) = resolved, owner Ethan Park.
- Performance window = 2026-07-30.
- Follow-up call = 2026-07-30 16:00 PT (pending calendar invite).

Thanks all — looking forward to the run.

Best,
Rachel
